error.message: Idempotency key must be 1-128 ASCII characters [A-Za-z0-9._:-]

400_INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY.handling: Client must fix the idempotency key format before re-sending.

error.message: Invalid or missing Bearer API key in Authorization header

401_UNAUTHORIZED.handling: Verify CREATIVANTA_API_KEY environment variable and tenant provisioning status.

403_FORBIDDEN_SCOPE.handling: Request updated API key with required scope from tenant administrator.

error.message: Resource 'cmp_unknown_id' not found in tenant workspace

404_NOT_FOUND.handling: Do not retry without changing resource ID. Verify tenant boundary.

error.message: A concurrent request with the same Idempotency-Key is currently being processed

409_IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.handling: Wait for Retry-After seconds and retry with the SAME Idempotency-Key.

error.message: Payload does not match previously committed request for this Idempotency-Key

409_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.handling: Generate a new unique Idempotency-Key for a distinct payload.

error.message: Cannot cancel job 'job_123' because it is already in terminal state 'succeeded'

409_JOB_TERMINAL.handling: Accept that the job has already finished; retrieve artifact or inspect failure.

error.message: The download grant URL has expired (TTL <= 300s)

410_GRANT_EXPIRED.handling: Call GET /v1/artifacts/{id}/download to refresh signed URL without rerendering.

error.message: Scene specification schema validation failed: missing required variable 'headline'

422_VALIDATION_FAILED.handling: Correct template variable payload according to template schema.

error.message: Rate limit exceeded (token bucket capacity 20, refill 1/s)

429_RATE_LIMITED.handling: Apply exponential backoff with jitter and retry with the SAME Idempotency-Key.

error.message: Tenant monthly render minutes quota exhausted

429_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.handling: Contact Creativanta account manager to increase tenant tier quota.

error.message: Engine cluster is shedding load or undergoing brief maintenance

503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.handling: Wait Retry-After duration and retry with the SAME Idempotency-Key.
